llm.summary: This skill is an instruction-only helper for planning Nextcloud support, with no executable code or hidden data access, though its automatic trigger terms are broader than ideal.

dimensions.detail: The instructions ask the agent to inspect technical constraints and provide guidance or verification steps, but do not request credentials, broad filesystem indexing, remote execution, or privileged environment access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown and YAML skill metadata/instructions; no install scripts, binaries, dependency declarations, or executable payloads were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad keywords such as add, support, feature, request, related, and problem, and allows implicit invocation, which could route unrelated requests into this helper.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, scheduled tasks, memory writes, privilege escalation, or tool modification behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe helping users produce workflows, checklists, analysis, or implementation guidance for adding Nextcloud support.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that the skill may activate on generic support or feature-request language. It is otherwise narrowly about Nextcloud support planning and does not ship code or request sensitive access.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger and implicit invocation concern is artifact-supported, but it is a routing-quality issue rather than a security hold because the skill is instruction-only and contains no hidden, destructive, credential-handling, or data-exfiltration behavior.
